name: Opposite-complex rollover context (cond_b generalization)
mechanism_en: Sink-node entries conditioned on an active OUT episode in an OPPOSITE-risk complex within 15 sessions — the generalized cond_b footprint (money must have somewhere to come from). NOTE: this is the fixed risk-opposite STAND-IN; the true library A1 (pairs drawn from the measured Flow-Routing Matrix / the 6 placebo-surviving cells) requires a routing-pair grammar primitive that does not yet exist — a reviewed grammar addition, tracked in the library. Nothing here is validated; exploratory tier.
mechanism_zh: 对侧风险板块出现活跃流出事件时的汇入节点入场（cond_b 泛化；真正的路由矩阵版本待路由对语法原语）。
lineage: ORACLE_COMPOUND_LIBRARY.md#family-a (stand-in; true A1 pending routing-pair primitive)

name: Cascade breadth conviction multiplier
mechanism_en: Cascade breadth: >=3 DISTINCT same-complex subsector nodes printing OUT onsets within 15 sessions (true node-breadth — an episode-count implementation would let one re-firing node satisfy the gate).
mechanism_zh: 当同一复合体中N>=3个子板块在15个交易日内出现流出启动时，退出的广度是汇节点的信念乘数。

name: Cohesion collapse-rebuild turn
mechanism_en: Washout with coordinated re-entry: cohesion_chg > 0.056, a FIXED PROXY for the panel_m q75 measured 2026-07-04 — NOT itself an FDR-validated threshold (the FDR-surviving group_flow finding was the cohesion_chg LEG at 20d, unrelated to this scalar). Quantile operator = future grammar addition; threshold will drift from q75 as data accrues.
mechanism_zh: 凝聚力在洗盘过程中下降（个股抛售），然后在转折点跃升（协调买入=机构重新入场）。复合条件：洗盘标志激活且凝聚力变化>0.056。

name: Rate-proxy washout with vol-subsiding conditioner
mechanism_en: Rate-proxy sector washouts are buyable only when bond vol (TLT realized vol) is subsiding. Vol-subsiding approximated as tlt_ret_10d rolling-std over 20d crossed_below its own 60d mean. The defensive rotation rates confound weaponized as a conditioner.
mechanism_zh: 利率代理板块的洗盘信号仅在债券波动率（TLT实际波动率）下降时可交易。波动率下降近似为tlt_ret_10d的20日滚动标准差跌破其60日均值。

name: Opposite-complex outflow with local RS repair
mechanism_en: Executes only when capital is recently leaving the opposite complex and the candidate node has just repaired its relative-strength line, so the rule targets nodes showing direct receipt of routed flow rather than buying the outflow event alone.
mechanism_zh: 仅当资金近期正流出对立板块群、且候选节点相对强度线刚刚修复时触发，锁定直接承接轮动资金的节点，而非单纯买入流出事件本身。

name: Same-complex stress survivor
mechanism_en: Executes when multiple same-complex peers have recently moved out but the candidate node still has positive relative strength and persistence, isolating the node that is absorbing capital inside a stressed complex.
mechanism_zh: 当同一板块群内多个同类节点近期流出、但候选节点仍保持正相对强度与持续性时触发，识别在承压板块群中吸纳资金的幸存节点。

name: Quiet leadership persistence
mechanism_en: Executes on nodes with positive relative strength, steady persistence, and low turnover, targeting leadership that is being accumulated without a noisy crowding surge.
mechanism_zh: 在相对强度为正、持续性稳定且换手率偏低的节点上触发，锁定在无喧嚣拥挤情况下被悄然吸筹的领导品种。

name: Group-confirmed RS turn
mechanism_en: Executes when the candidate node crosses into positive relative strength while its internal cohesion and breadth are already firm, requiring the turn to be confirmed by broad participation instead of a single price impulse.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点在内部凝聚度与广度已然稳固时上穿至正相对强度触发，要求该转折由广泛参与确认，而非单根价格脉冲。

name: Early acceleration repair before chase
mechanism_en: Executes when weekly velocity has turned positive while acceleration is still modest and relative strength is positive, targeting the early repair window before the move becomes an extended acceleration chase.
mechanism_zh: 当周动能转正、但加速度仍温和且相对强度为正时触发，锁定行情演变为过度加速追涨之前的早期修复窗口。

name: Velocity curve inflection
mechanism_en: Executes when short-term velocity rises above medium-term velocity while longer velocity is still weak, targeting a fresh rotation inflection rather than established momentum.
mechanism_zh: 当短期动能上穿中期动能、而长期动能仍疲弱时触发，锁定新鲜的轮动拐点而非已确立的动能。

name: Risk-on breadth-confirmed rotation
mechanism_en: Executes only when the broad market is above its long trend and volatility is not elevated, then requires the candidate node to show positive breadth and relative strength, targeting pro-cyclical allocation periods rather than defensive shock behavior.
mechanism_zh: 仅当大盘位于长期趋势之上且波动率不高时触发，再要求候选节点呈现正广度与相对强度，锁定顺周期配置阶段而非防御性冲击行为。

name: Rate-relief RS repair
mechanism_en: Executes when bonds have recently firmed and the candidate node crosses back into positive relative strength with improving cohesion, targeting sectors that respond to easing rate pressure without relying on a raw washout trigger.
mechanism_zh: 当债券近期企稳、候选节点在凝聚度改善的同时上穿回正相对强度时触发，锁定对利率压力缓解作出反应的板块，而不依赖原始洗盘触发。

name: Leadership after turnover cooling
mechanism_en: Executes when a positive-relative-strength node remains persistent after turnover crosses back below elevated levels, targeting leadership whose crowded burst has cooled without losing sponsorship.
mechanism_zh: 当正相对强度节点在换手率回落至偏高水平之下后仍保持持续性时触发，锁定拥挤脉冲已降温但未失去支撑的领导品种。

name: Internal breadth leads price repair
mechanism_en: Executes when breadth and cohesion are improving while short-term velocity is not yet strong, targeting cases where internal participation improves before price momentum is obvious.
mechanism_zh: 当广度与凝聚度改善、而短期动能尚未走强时触发，锁定内部参与度先于价格动能改善的情形。

name: Same-complex inflow with breadth repair
mechanism_en: Executes when recent same-complex inflow is present and the candidate node's internal breadth has just moved back above neutral, requiring routed capital to coincide with broadening participation inside the receiving complex.
mechanism_zh: 当近期存在同一板块群的资金流入、且候选节点内部广度刚刚回升至中性上方时触发，要求轮入资金与承接板块群内部参与度扩张同时出现。

name: Broad inflow with low churn
mechanism_en: Executes when a recent market-wide inflow episode is present and the candidate node participates with below-elevated turnover, targeting routed capital entering without a disorderly volume spike.
mechanism_zh: 当近期出现全市场范围的资金流入、且候选节点以未过热的换手率参与时触发，锁定在无失序放量情况下承接轮入资金的节点。

name: Outflow tape with candidate repair
mechanism_en: Executes when there has been recent outflow somewhere in the sector map but the candidate node's breadth and cohesion are improving, selecting nodes firming while capital is displaced elsewhere.
mechanism_zh: 当板块图谱中某处近期出现流出、但候选节点的广度与凝聚度正在改善时触发，选取在资金仍于别处被挤出之际率先企稳的节点。

name: Risk-on stable participation
mechanism_en: Executes only in a broad risk-on tape, then requires neutral-or-better relative strength, positive breadth, and contained turnover, buying sectors whose participation is steady rather than surge-driven.
mechanism_zh: 仅在广泛的risk-on行情中触发，再要求候选节点具备中性或更好的相对强度、正广度与受控换手率，买入参与度稳健而非脉冲驱动的板块。

name: Cohesion holds during elevated volatility
mechanism_en: Executes when volatility is elevated but the candidate node still has above-neutral cohesion and breadth, targeting sectors whose internal participation stays organized during a rougher tape.
mechanism_zh: 当波动率偏高、但候选节点仍保持中性上方的凝聚度与广度时触发，锁定在较颠簸行情中内部参与度依然有序的板块。

name: Short pullback while RS holds
mechanism_en: Executes when weekly velocity crosses below monthly velocity while relative strength and breadth remain nonnegative, entering a cooling phase inside an intact rotation rather than chasing an acceleration burst.
mechanism_zh: 当周动能下穿月动能、而相对强度与广度仍非负时触发，在完整轮动内进入降温阶段，而非追逐加速脉冲。

name: Acceleration recovers from negative with breadth support
mechanism_en: Executes when acceleration crosses back above zero while breadth is above neutral and turnover is not elevated, targeting early mechanical repair with participation support before a crowded thrust.
mechanism_zh: 当加速度回升上穿零、广度已在中性上方且换手率不高时触发，锁定在拥挤推动之前、具备参与度支撑的早期机械修复。

name: Rate relief with breadth turn
mechanism_en: Executes when the rate proxy has improved and volatility is below shock levels, then requires candidate breadth to cross above neutral, buying sector participation that appears as rate pressure eases.
mechanism_zh: 当利率代理改善、波动率低于冲击水平、候选节点广度上穿中性时触发，买入随利率压力缓解而显现的板块参与度。

name: Turnover spike resolves with participation intact
mechanism_en: Executes when turnover falls back below elevated levels while breadth and cohesion remain above neutral, targeting sectors where a positioning flush cools without damaging internal participation.
mechanism_zh: 当换手率回落至偏高水平之下、而广度与凝聚度仍在中性上方时触发，锁定持仓冲洗降温但内部参与度未受损的板块。

name: Cohesion rebuild before RS confirmation
mechanism_en: Executes when the cohesion-rebuild flag is active and breadth is back above neutral while relative strength has not yet crossed strongly positive, targeting internal information improvement before obvious relative-price confirmation.
mechanism_zh: 当凝聚度重建标志激活、广度回到中性上方、而相对强度尚未明显转正时触发，锁定在相对价格确认之前的内部信息改善。

name: Washout under rate relief
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while the rate proxy is positive and vol is below crisis, buying washout pressure only when the macro discount-rate backdrop is not actively tightening.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、利率代理为正且波动率低于危机水平时触发，仅在宏观贴现率背景未主动收紧时买入洗盘压力。

name: Washout inside broad-market uptrend
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while SPY remains above its 200-day trend, treating the sector washout as local displacement inside a still-positive broad regime.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、而SPY仍在200日趋势之上时触发，将板块洗盘视作仍为正的大盘环境内的局部错位。

name: Washout with volatility below panic
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with volatility elevated only below panic, separating tradable stress from broad liquidation.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、但波动率仅在恐慌水平之下抬升时触发，区分可交易的压力与大盘清算式抛售。

name: Washout during opposite-complex outflow
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while an opposite complex has a recent outflow episode, testing whether displaced capital and local capitulation overlap before rotation rebalances.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、而对立板块群近期出现流出时触发，检验被挤出的资金与本地投降能否在轮动再平衡前重叠。

name: Washout during same-complex outflow cascade
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 during a recent same-complex multi-node outflow, targeting capitulation inside a dense local routing cascade rather than a standalone washout.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且近期同一板块群出现多节点流出时触发，锁定密集本地轮动级联中的投降，而非孤立洗盘。

name: Cohesion rebuild after same-complex outflow
mechanism_en: cohesion_rebuild>0 after recent same-complex outflow, looking for internal repair after capital has been forced out of nearby nodes.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点在近期同一板块群流出之后出现活跃的凝聚度重建信号时触发，寻找在资金被迫挤出邻近节点后的内部修复。

name: Cohesion rebuild during opposite-complex displacement
mechanism_en: cohesion_rebuild>0 while the opposite complex shows recent outflow, pairing local internal repair with external capital displacement.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点出现活跃凝聚度重建信号、而对立板块群近期流出时触发，将本地内部修复与外部资金错位配对。

name: Plain cohesion rebuild with broad risk filter
mechanism_en: cohesion_rebuild>0 with vix below panic, keeping the rebuild flag as the primary trigger behind only a broad tradability filter.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点出现活跃凝聚度重建信号、且波动率低于恐慌水平时触发，以凝聚度重建为主触发、仅用宽泛可交易性过滤。

name: Cohesion rebuild under rate relief
mechanism_en: cohesion_rebuild>0 while the rate proxy is positive, testing internal repair when discount-rate pressure is easing.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点出现活跃凝聚度重建信号、而利率代理为正时触发，在贴现率压力缓解而非上升时检验内部修复。

name: Washout with positioning stress
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with turnover above normal but not extreme, using elevated activity as evidence of positioning stress being processed.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且换手率高于正常但未极端时触发，以washout_w为触发、以活跃度抬升作为持仓压力被处理的证据。

name: Washout during tighter same-complex outflow
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while >=2 same-complex nodes have recent onset outflow in a shorter 15-session window, targeting capitulation inside fresher local routing stress.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且近期15个交易日内至少两个同板块群节点出现onset流出时触发，锁定更新鲜的本地轮动压力中的投降。

name: Washout during three-node same-complex outflow
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while >=3 same-complex nodes have recent onset outflow, testing whether a denser local cascade improves the capitulation entry.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且至少三个同板块群节点近期出现onset流出时触发，检验更密集的本地级联是否改善投降式入场。

name: Washout during confirmed same-complex outflow
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while a same-complex outflow episode has reached confirmed tier, requiring local flow stress to mature before buying the washout.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且某同板块群流出事件已达confirmed层级时触发，要求本地资金流压力在买入洗盘前趋于成熟。

name: Washout during two-node opposite-complex outflow
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while >=2 opposite-complex nodes have recent onset outflow, pairing local capitulation with broader displacement away from another complex.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且至少两个对立板块群节点近期出现onset流出时触发，将本地投降与来自另一板块群的更广错位配对。

reversion.note: 6-leg reversion gauntlet PASS; ~21-session time-exit approx operator 20-25d hold; display-only, apply transaction-cost haircut before live weight.

name: Washout during fresh broad outflow cluster
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 while >=3 nodes anywhere have onset outflow in a short window, buying local capitulation during active cross-map liquidation pressure.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且短窗口内板块图谱任意三个节点出现onset流出时触发，在活跃的跨图清算压力中买入本地投降。

name: Washout during same-complex outflow with negative weekly velocity
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with negative weekly velocity while same-complex outflow is active, requiring both local price stress and local flow displacement.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、周动能为负且同板块群流出活跃时触发，同时要求本地价格压力与本地资金错位。

name: Washout with deep weekly velocity stress
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with materially negative weekly velocity, using price-speed stress as the secondary conditioner behind the washout trigger.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且周动能明显为负时触发，以价格速度压力作为洗盘触发之后的次级条件。

name: Washout with negative acceleration stress
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with accel_z below zero, buying capitulation while the speed impulse is still stressed rather than after acceleration has turned positive.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且加速度z分数仍低于零时触发，在速度脉冲仍受压时买入投降，而非在加速度已转正之后。

name: Washout with loose cohesion repair
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with positive cohesion_chg, keeping washout as the trigger while requiring only a broad internal-repair signal.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且凝聚度变化为正时触发，以洗盘为触发、仅要求宽泛的内部修复信号。

name: Washout with persistent selling pressure
mechanism_en: washout_w>0 with persistence below neutral, treating sustained adverse positioning pressure as the conditioner behind the capitulation trigger.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点处于周度洗盘、且持续性低于中性时触发，将持续的不利持仓压力作为投降触发背后的条件。

name: Fresh same-complex inflow with nonnegative RS
mechanism_en: Executes when money is entering peers in the same complex and the node is no longer lagging the benchmark, so the rule buys local participation in a nearby allocation wave.

name: Same-complex inflow relay with weekly velocity turn
mechanism_en: Executes after nearby nodes receive inflow and the candidate's weekly velocity crosses positive, buying a relay from complex-level demand into the individual node.

name: Opposite-complex outflow with candidate RS above zero
mechanism_en: Executes when capital is leaving the opposite complex while the candidate already has positive relative strength, buying the apparent destination of cross-complex routing.

name: Opposite outflow with positive RS but capped acceleration
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex selling is visible, the candidate is leading, and acceleration is not stretched, buying a routed flow before the move looks crowded.

name: Confirmed broad inflow with positive monthly velocity
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflow is confirmed and the candidate has positive one-month velocity, buying nodes already being marked up during a market-wide allocation push.

name: Broad inflow with weekly StochRSI crossing midline
mechanism_en: Executes when system-level inflow appears and the node's weekly oscillator crosses back through neutral, buying a candidate that is joining fresh demand rather than remaining oversold.

name: Same-complex inflow in non-panic volatility
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflows occur while volatility is below panic levels, buying flow continuation when routing is less likely to be emergency liquidation noise.

name: Opposite outflow during broad-market uptrend
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow happens while SPY is above its 200-day average, buying allocation rotation rather than defensive cash raising.

name: Same-complex outflow survivor with oscillator support
mechanism_en: Executes when peers in the same complex are seeing outflow but the candidate's weekly StochRSI remains above neutral, buying the node that is resisting local selling pressure.

name: Confirmed same-complex inflow with persistence floor
mechanism_en: Executes when repeated same-complex inflow coincides with a candidate that has maintained directional persistence, buying an allocation wave that is already orderly in the node.

name: Opposite-complex inflow with candidate lag still shallow
mechanism_en: Executes when the opposite complex receives inflow but the candidate is only mildly lagging, buying nodes that may be next in the rotation rather than deeply rejected.

name: Broad outflow with candidate positive RS
mechanism_en: Executes during broad outflow episodes only when the candidate still has positive relative strength, buying sectors that function as active shelters inside de-risking.

name: Broad outflow with monthly velocity holding above zero
mechanism_en: Executes when multiple nodes show outflow but the candidate's one-month velocity remains positive, buying the node that is still being accumulated over the intermediate window.

name: Confirmed opposite outflow with cool acceleration
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow is confirmed and the candidate's acceleration z-score is below a chase threshold, buying a routed destination before it becomes statistically hot.

name: Confirmed broad inflow with RS crossing positive
mechanism_en: Executes when confirmed broad inflow is present and the candidate crosses into positive relative strength, buying the point where system demand reaches the node.

name: Same inflow despite negative TLT tape
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow occurs even while TLT has negative 10-day returns, buying demand that appears strong enough to overcome rate pressure.

name: Same inflow with rate tailwind
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow and positive TLT returns coincide, buying sectors receiving local demand while rates are easing.

name: Opposite outflow in elevated volatility with RS leader
mechanism_en: Executes when capital leaves an opposite complex during elevated volatility and the candidate is already leading, buying the sector being selected in stress rather than calm tape.

name: Broad inflow with VIX below median
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflows occur while volatility is below median, buying allocation expansion rather than stress substitution.

name: Same-complex outflow with candidate weekly velocity crossing positive
mechanism_en: Executes when local peers are seeing outflow but the candidate's weekly velocity turns positive, buying counterflow selection inside a weak complex.

name: Opposite inflow spillover with candidate weekly velocity above monthly
mechanism_en: Executes when the opposite complex receives inflow and the candidate's short velocity exceeds monthly velocity, buying spillover acceleration from the first destination into the next candidate.

name: Confirmed same outflow with RS holding nonnegative
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex outflow is confirmed but the candidate keeps nonnegative relative strength, buying a node that institutions are not selling with its peer group.

name: Undeniable opposite outflow under moderate volatility
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex selling is undeniable but volatility is not at panic extremes, buying the likely recipient of a large but still allocative rotation.

name: Undeniable broad inflow with price already firm
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflow is undeniable and the candidate has nonnegative one-week velocity, buying nodes that are participating in a large allocation episode.

name: Opposite outflow with candidate not overbought
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex selling appears and the candidate's weekly StochRSI is below the overbought zone, buying routed demand before oscillator crowding is extreme.

name: Same inflow with weekly K crossing above D
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow is present and the candidate's weekly stochastic line crosses above its signal line, buying a local flow event with fresh oscillator confirmation.

name: Broad outflow with candidate oscillator cooling but RS intact
mechanism_en: Executes during broad outflow when the candidate's weekly K is below D but RS remains positive, buying a leader after short-term cooling inside de-risking.

name: Opposite inflow during rate relief with candidate RS repair
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex inflow occurs under positive TLT returns and the candidate crosses into positive RS, buying follow-on rotation during easing-rate tape.

name: Same inflow with persistence below crowding levels
mechanism_en: Executes on same-complex inflow when candidate persistence is moderate rather than very smooth, buying fresh routing before the trend becomes fully consensus.

name: Same outflow with low persistence and candidate RS hold
mechanism_en: Executes when local outflow appears in a choppy tape but the candidate holds relative strength, buying selective demand rather than a mature trend.

name: Broad inflow after short weekly dip
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflow arrives while the candidate's weekly velocity is still slightly negative but monthly velocity is positive, buying a pullback into active allocation.

name: Confirmed opposite inflow with candidate avoiding breakdown
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex inflow is confirmed but the candidate's velocity is not breaking down, buying nodes that remain viable for the next routing leg.

name: Confirmed broad outflow with candidate RS crossing up
mechanism_en: Executes when broad outflow is confirmed and the candidate crosses above zero RS, buying active selection into the node as other exposures are being sold.

name: Opposite outflow while candidate acceleration still negative
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow appears before the candidate's acceleration has turned positive, buying a potential recipient before price acceleration is visible.

name: Same inflow with acceleration crossing positive
mechanism_en: Executes when local inflow coincides with the candidate's acceleration crossing above zero, buying the point where complex demand begins to alter price slope.

name: Broad inflow with daily return crossing positive
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflow is present and the candidate's daily return flips positive, buying immediate participation in the allocation day rather than a delayed momentum state.

name: Opposite outflow with candidate daily return nonnegative
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow occurs and the candidate closes nonnegative on the day, buying visible same-day destination behavior.

name: Same inflow with internal breadth crossing above half
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow is already the flow trigger and post-2021 internal breadth crosses above half, probing whether local demand is supported by constituent participation.

name: Opposite outflow with turnover below stress spike
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow is the flow trigger and post-2021 turnover stress is below a spike threshold, probing routed demand without obvious churn blowoff.

name: Broad inflow with positive cohesion change
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflow is already present and post-2021 cohesion change is positive, probing whether routed demand is synchronizing constituents.

name: Same outflow with cohesion still high
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex outflow is present but post-2021 cohesion remains high, probing whether the candidate is part of an organized group response rather than isolated noise.

name: Confirmed broad inflow with cohesion rebuild flag
mechanism_en: Executes when confirmed broad inflow is the trigger and the post-2021 rebuild flag is active, probing whether allocation is arriving after internal repair has started.

name: High-volatility inflow with RS above zero
mechanism_en: Executes when volatility is elevated and the candidate has positive RS during an inflow episode, buying sectors selected while investors are still risk-sensitive.

name: Broad uptrend same inflow after weekly dip
mechanism_en: Executes when SPY is above its 200-day average, same-complex inflow appears, and the candidate's weekly velocity is still negative, buying pullbacks during allocative risk-on rotation.

name: Rate-stress opposite outflow destination
mechanism_en: Executes when TLT is falling, opposite-complex outflow occurs, and candidate RS is positive, buying sectors that attract capital even as rate pressure rises.

name: Acceleration z-score crosses positive during inflow
mechanism_en: Executes when an inflow episode is present and acceleration z-score crosses above zero, buying the moment flow begins to register in normalized slope.

name: Weekly velocity overtakes monthly during opposite outflow
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow is visible and the candidate's one-week velocity exceeds its one-month velocity, buying short-horizon acceleration into a routed-flow backdrop.

name: Fresh inflow while three-month velocity remains negative
mechanism_en: Executes when fresh inflow appears before the candidate's three-month velocity has recovered, buying early rotation out of a still-negative intermediate base.

name: Persistence crosses above half during inflow
mechanism_en: Executes when inflow is present and directional persistence crosses above a basic trend-quality threshold, buying flow only once the candidate stops behaving randomly.

name: Inflow with oscillator crossing below overbought
mechanism_en: Executes when inflow is active but weekly StochRSI crosses down through 80, buying a cooled but still-flow-supported node rather than a fresh high-chase print.

name: Opposite outflow after overbought reset
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow is visible and the candidate's oscillator is below 80 but above 50, buying routed demand after a mild reset rather than peak oscillator strength.

name: Same inflow from oversold weekly oscillator
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow arrives while the candidate's weekly oscillator is still below 50 but weekly velocity has turned positive, buying early base relay before full oscillator recovery.

name: Broad inflow with RS still below zero but improving price
mechanism_en: Executes when broad inflow appears while RS is still negative but weekly velocity is positive, buying a laggard only after system demand starts lifting price.

name: Same inflow with turnover crossing below stress
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow is active and post-2021 turnover z-score crosses below a stress threshold, probing flow continuation after churn cools.

name: Opposite outflow with breadth above low threshold
mechanism_en: Executes when opposite-complex outflow is the routing trigger and post-2021 breadth is above a low participation floor, probing whether the candidate is a real destination rather than a single-name drag.

name: Fresh inflow with cohesion crossing above midlevel
mechanism_en: Executes when inflow is already present and post-2021 cohesion crosses above a midlevel, probing whether the allocation wave is becoming synchronized internally.

name: Washout with fresh inflow rather than outflow
mechanism_en: Executes when the node is in weekly washout but an inflow episode is occurring, buying a capitulated candidate that is receiving new allocation rather than merely rebounding from selling pressure.

name: Washout with same-complex inflow and RS not deeply negative
mechanism_en: Executes when weekly washout coincides with same-complex inflow and RS is not deeply negative, buying capitulation only when nearby allocation is arriving.

name: Washout with opposite-complex inflow spillover
mechanism_en: Executes when the node is washed out while the opposite complex receives inflow and the node's weekly velocity is stabilizing, buying a delayed spillover candidate from an oversold base.

name: Low-volatility same inflow with RS repair
mechanism_en: Executes when same-complex inflow happens in low-volatility tape and RS crosses positive, buying rotation that is occurring through orderly allocation rather than stress substitution.

name: High-volatility broad outflow shelter with monthly velocity positive
mechanism_en: Executes when broad outflow occurs in high volatility but the candidate's monthly velocity remains positive, buying sectors that are being retained through stress.

name: Rate relief broad inflow with three-month velocity below zero
mechanism_en: Executes when TLT is positive and broad inflow appears while three-month velocity remains negative, buying early rotation into rate-sensitive recoveries before the intermediate trend confirms.

name: Rate stress same outflow survivor
mechanism_en: Executes when TLT is negative and same-complex outflow occurs but the candidate keeps positive RS, buying sectors that resist both local selling and rate pressure.

name: Downtrend broad outflow shelter with RS positive
mechanism_en: Executes when SPY is below its 200-day average and broad outflow occurs while the candidate has positive RS, buying defensive selection in a broad-market downtrend.

name: Uptrend opposite inflow catch-up with weekly velocity positive
mechanism_en: Executes when SPY is above its 200-day average, opposite-complex inflow appears, and the candidate has positive weekly velocity, buying follow-on rotation in a risk-on market.

name: Washout with dollar relief
mechanism_en: Weekly washout (washout_w>0) coincides with the dollar's 10-day change turning down (dollar_chg_10d crosses below 0) while relative strength is not yet broken (rs>-0.04): buys a pressure-release reversion in globally-sensitive sectors as the dollar headwind relents.
mechanism_zh: 板块处于周度洗盘（washout_w>0）、美元10日变动转跌（dollar_chg_10d 下穿0）、且相对强度尚未破位（rs>-0.04）时触发：在美元逆风缓解之际买入全球敏感板块的压力释放式反弹。

reversion.note: 6-leg reversion gauntlet PASS; ~21-session time-exit approx operator 20-25d hold; display-only, apply transaction-cost haircut before live weight.

name: Same-complex outflow after credit stress eases
mechanism_en: A same-complex onset outflow (forced selling) coincides with high-yield credit spreads ceasing to widen (hy_oas_chg_10d crosses below 0) while StochRSI K is still sub-60: buys the reversion once macro credit pressure stops accelerating.
mechanism_zh: 同板块群近期onset流出（强制抛售），同时高收益信用利差停止走扩（hy_oas_chg_10d 下穿0）、且StochRSI K 仍低于60时触发：在宏观信用压力不再加速时买入均值回归。

reversion.note: 6-leg reversion gauntlet PASS; ~21-session time-exit approx operator 20-25d hold; display-only, apply transaction-cost haircut before live weight.

name: V-bottom: acceleration repair from extreme with oscillator oversold
mechanism_en: Trend acceleration repairs from a statistical extreme (accel_z crosses above -2) while StochRSI K remains oversold (<30): the second derivative heals before price momentum turns, catching a V-bottom without relying on washout or outflow (a mechanism distinct from the washout family).
mechanism_zh: 趋势加速度自统计极值修复（accel_z 上穿-2），而StochRSI K 仍处超卖区（<30）：二阶导在价格动能转向前先行修复，捕捉不依赖洗盘或资金流出的V型底部（区别于洗盘家族的独立机制）。

reversion.note: 6-leg reversion gauntlet PASS; ~21-session time-exit approx operator 20-25d hold; display-only, apply transaction-cost haircut before live weight.
